svg.title: Time that the coupling adds to each 1 ms step of a NEST network
svg.desc: Brunel network with 1,000 and 10,000 neurons on 1, 4, and 8 NEST threads, one exchange after every 1 ms of simulated time. NCP 2 adds 23 to 32 µs with a Rust host and 50 to 61 µs with a Python host. NCP 1.0.1 adds 228 to 248 µs and 492 to 524 µs. A raw round trip without a protocol takes 8 to 11 µs. Each point is the median of three blocks; its bar spans the block values.
